name: JoAi: List Contacts

description.en: View CRM contacts for your team with optional filters for search, follow-ups, tags, custom properties, and pagination.
description.de: Zeige CRM-Kontakte deines Teams mit optionalen Filtern für Suche, Follow-ups, Tags, Custom Properties und Pagination.
description.es: View CRM contacts for your team with optional filters for search, follow-ups, tags, custom properties, and pagination.
description.fr: View CRM contacts for your team with optional filters for search, follow-ups, tags, custom properties, and pagination.
description.it: View CRM contacts for your team with optional filters for search, follow-ups, tags, custom properties, and pagination.
description.ro: View CRM contacts for your team with optional filters for search, follow-ups, tags, custom properties, and pagination.

bot: Use this when the user wants to see, list, or check their contacts or CRM. Prefer filters for follow-up queues: followup_overdue=true for overdue chases, waiting_on=true for open follow-ups, prop as key:value (e.g. onboarding-stage:new).

inputs.name: Search

description.en: Search contacts by name, email, phone, or company
description.de: Kontakte nach Name, E-Mail, Telefon oder Firma durchsuchen
description.es: Search contacts by name, email, phone, or company
description.fr: Search contacts by name, email, phone, or company
description.ro: Search contacts by name, email, phone, or company
description.it: Search contacts by name, email, phone, or company

inputs.bot: Search term for contacts. Omit to return all matching other filters.

inputs.name: Follow-up overdue

description.en: When true, only contacts whose follow-up date has passed with no activity since
description.de: Wenn true, nur Kontakte deren Follow-up-Datum überschritten ist und seitdem keine Aktivität hatten

inputs.bot: Pass true/1 to list overdue follow-ups only. Omit otherwise.

inputs.name: Waiting on

description.en: When true, only contacts with a nextFollowUpAt set; when false, only without one
description.de: Wenn true, nur Kontakte mit gesetztem nextFollowUpAt; wenn false, nur ohne

inputs.bot: Pass true/1 for open follow-ups, false/0 for contacts without a follow-up. Omit otherwise.

inputs.name: Property

description.en: Custom property filter as key:value (e.g. onboarding-stage:new)

inputs.bot: Filter by a contact custom property using key:value, e.g. onboarding-stage:new or business-team-slug:atsv.

inputs.name: Tags
inputs.bot: One tag or comma-separated tags to match (any).

inputs.name: Has phone

description.en: When true, only contacts with a phone number; when false, only without
description.de: Wenn true, nur Kontakte mit Telefonnummer; wenn false, nur ohne

inputs.bot: Pass true/1 or false/0. Omit otherwise.

inputs.name: Page
inputs.bot: 1-based page number. Omit for the first page.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.es: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.fr: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.it: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.ro: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
